subject: Using MIRT for creating pairwise preference measures

messages.author: d6b65219d5ee044d
messages.subject: Using MIRT for creating pairwise preference measures
parts:
Hi folks,

I'm curious if anyone has looked into using MIRT to create pairwise preference measures of non-cognitive traits (e.g., personality). I have built measures of personality traits using the GGUM and am interested in creating a pairwise preference form of assessment.

Thanks in advance,

Chris

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Using MIRT for creating pairwise preference measures
parts:
Hi Chris,

Although it didn't appear in this in the final version of this article ( https://journals.plos.org/plosone/article?id=10.1371/journal.pone.0196292 ), Chen-Wei used mirt for pairwise preference data via the createItem() function. While it was successful, reviewers felt it to be too much for the paper, and recommend removing the pairwise material. If you contact Chen-Wei directly I'm sure he'd be happy to share some code with you. HTH.
 
Phil
